name: dynwinrt-electron-aion-chat-sample
description: Aion Instruct Preview streaming chat in Electron using dynwinrt

scripts.configure: npm run generate && npm run build && winapp node add-electron-debug-identity --manifest Package.appxmanifest
scripts.start:generated: npm run build && winapp node add-electron-debug-identity --manifest Package.appxmanifest && electron .
scripts.clear-identity: winapp node clear-electron-debug-identity && winapp unregister --manifest Package.appxmanifest --force
